description: RS485 temperature and humidity transmitter with an SHT20 sensor, Modbus RTU
source: XY-MD02 Modbus RTU RS485 SHT20 Temperature Humidity Transmitter manual

sources.title: XY-MD02 Modbus RTU RS485 SHT20 Temperature Humidity Transmitter manual

notes: Function codes 0x03, 0x04, 0x06 and 0x10. Temperature and humidity are input registers (FC04); the settings are holding registers (FC03 read, FC06 or FC10 write).
Addresses are the ones in the manual's frames: temperature is read from address 0x0001 (frame 01 04 00 01 00 01).

The manual's register table gives the baud rate as 0 = 9600, 1 = 14400, 2 = 19200, but its write example sets 0x2580 (9600) in that register. Which one the device takes is not confirmed; the labels follow the table.

The manual does not give the corrections' encoding. The serial settings table of its UART protocol section (9600, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, no parity) is used as the default here; the Modbus section does not repeat them.
An older conversion of the Omni Console library lists the factory defaults as 8N2 (2 stop bits). The manual gives 1 stop bit, which is used here; neither is confirmed on a device.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Temperature
registers.description: Signed value in tenths of a degree (0x0131 is 30.5 °C, 0xFF33 is -20.5 °C)

registers.name: Humidity
registers.description: Relative humidity in tenths of a percent (0x0222 is 54.6 %RH)

registers.name: Baud rate
registers.description: The register table lists 0, 1 and 2; the manual's write example uses 0x2580 (9600) instead, see the notes

registers.name: Temperature correction
registers.description: Range -10 to 10 °C in the manual; how the value is encoded (whole degrees or tenths) is not stated

registers.name: Humidity correction
registers.description: Range -10 to 10 %RH in the manual; how the value is encoded (whole percent or tenths) is not stated
